body.content: أبغى ٢٠ كرتون خيار و١٠ كراتين برتقال، كم المجموع؟
هلا 👋 حسب أسعار اليوم: خيار (٥ كجم) × ٢٠ = ٥٦٠ ر.س، برتقال (٨ كجم) × ١٠ = ٤٢٠ ر.س. الإجمالي ٩٨٠ ر.س. هل أؤكد الطلب؟
Send 50 boxes of mangoes for tomorrow morning
We have 32 boxes of mangoes (4 kg) in stock right now. I've sent your request for 50 to our team — they'll confirm shortly.
Salam, what's the price of tomatoes today? Need 30 cartons
Wa alaikum salam 👋 Tomatoes (5 kg carton): SAR 35, today's price. 30 cartons are available. 30 × SAR 35 = SAR 1,050. Shall I place the order?
✅ Your order is confirmed. Thank you!
